algorithm.method: Bottom-up stable merge sort, strict > comparison, left wins ties, reusable per-Search scratch, copy back only when needed
algorithm.complexity: O(n log n) time / O(n) scratch
algorithm.NaN: Excluded: engine priorities finite. Infinity, signed zero, subnormal tested.

fixedWork.require: Every iteration scores, candidate order, nodes identical; complete requested depth

hostTime.rule: Fresh reachable observations only; serial non-overlapping compute; report legality, deadlines and fallback, no identical-tree claim

matches.stopRule: Complete frozen pairs, no tuning or outcome-based replacement

publication: Experimental only; no production or default change.
